notes.title: Check our new game: Rebel Roar
notes.notes:
Hello Urbekitas,

We are working on a new game [b]Rebel Roar[/b], this time it's a roguelike card game where you control anthropomorphic animals in a cyberpunk world, fighting against humans: Rebel Roar. What's new, is that you can mix decks by making your character, so if you have a [b]ninja cat[/b], you have the feline deck and the ninja deck. You can make anything from a [b]hacker possum[/b] to a [b]gunner rhino[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062700/Rebel_Roar/

Anecdotally, we almost called it "against the sapiens" or "No more pets!!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/d037c18407cdc79d9929cf6bab8a9d60943f05fc.gif[/img]

Also, we changed the name of the studio from [b]Estudios Kremlinois[/b] to [b]Fridus Studio[/b].

It was called Kremlinois Studios because with a friend we started making games in a neighbourhood in Paris called [url=https://www.google.cl/maps/@48.8084947,2.351762,3a,84.4y,224.81h,93.19t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sJTioNjhdd7D8G0vr4V3rKQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu]Kremlin-Bicêtre[/url] (quite Urbeky!), the people there were called Kremlinois. And "studios" with an E because in Spanish we can't pronounce "studios". But after the war, many people thought that Kremlinois was an apology for the war! Nothing could be further from the truth! So we decided to name it Fridus Studio.

We have now a cool logo too
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/63791ae2b2b91c3a7540ad5f1b2601063e301465.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/f8bbbf8c005eeda485301137de2590812e3a789e.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/b4d57c8eb85cb4666415e535461e7e723f3cc998.jpg[/img]

Fridus is short for Frida, the name of my cat who appears in many Urbek easter eggs (how many Fridus did you find?). She accompanied me a lot in the development of Urbek, but now she is no longer with us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/f6c808064dcd78affe80e0ee68bb5f1010e00330.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.7.6 version
notes.notes:
Hello Urbekites,
Thank you very much for all the feedback, I improved a lot of mistakes and added other things you asked for. If you find mistakes or things to improve, don't hesitate to tell me, thanks!

Here is the list of changes for the 1.7.6 version. Changes are for main game (🔶) and train DLC

[h2]🔶Main game[/h2]
[list]
[*] Zoom works better now
[*] When destroying half of an urban forest, an advanced park does not magically appear
[/list]

[h2]Train DLC[/h2]

[h3]Fixed bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Production of train stations is displayed and works immediately
[*] Trains no longer overlap as much, if that happens, one will stop to let the other one keep moving
[*] Train tutorial loads correctly when loading a game.
[*] Little dessert cruiser no longer sticks together
[*] Two-storey fishermen's houses now get train bonuses
[*] Desert goods industry now gets train bonus correctly
[*] It is no longer shown that the train bridges were unlocked on the archipelago map
[/list]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] There is now a hotkey for building train-related buildings, it is the letter T and can be changed like the other keys.
[*] New train line replaces old one when building on top of it (no need to press ALT)
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stations now have a limit to the bonus they can give. The smallest station can max increase the production of a construction by 50%, while the largest station can max increase the production of a construction by 300%.
[*] The largest station now has a larger radius.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha v0.2.0 released
notes.notes:
Thanks to the alphatesters, there have been many improvements over the first alpha version

[h3][b]Fixed bugs[/b][/h3]
Now you can build on edges
Modern silos are no longer abandoned immediately
River meets edge of the map as it should
Exclamation mark now disappears when appropriate
In the pause menu cars and pedestrians now don't move
Isometric camera does not leave the map now
Now when changing speed everything works fine, before the resources were accumulated when returning to the original speed.
Fixed bug that existed when demolishing buildings when you had the minimum income rate of work (could be used as exploit)
Fixed that moving too far away from the bottom corner of the screen made the buildings look weird

[h3][b]Graphics[/b][/h3]
Correction in translations
You can see when button is pressed
There is dynamic information of the construction being built
Slight changes in displaying information about buildings
Resources have a small description when hovering over their icon.
A little more information about schools
Now when building and selecting a construction the[b] area of influence is displayed[/b]
Ghost building before building
A notification when a building has been unlocked
In the list of possible upgrades for a building, a message indicates if the building is ready to be upgraded.
It is now clearer when resources are missing, a red background appears.
Cursor now locks in walk mode
Cars and pedestrians move at the same speed as the game, so if paused, they don't move.
When you exit the walking view, you return to the same position you were in before.
Country house is now called Farm house
Buildings pop up with a little animation

[h3][b]Tutorial[/b][/h3]
Previous messages can be viewed in the tutorial
Messages don't scroll automatically, you have to click next, so you can read them.
Some passages are better explained
The tutorial now goes further into the game.

[h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3]
Lumbercamps and lumberjack cabins cut trees more slowly
Lumberjack cabins produce more energy
It takes more population to unlock buildings, before it was too fast.
Warehouses -1 beauty
Increased the price of some buildings
School can now be further away for houses that need education.

[h3][b]Controls[/b][/h3]
Space to pause
Ctrl to switch to walking mode
right-click as magnifying glass
middle-click to drag and move
right-click to undo when building areas (farms/housing)

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
Option to [b]save and load[/b] a game.
If a building was unlocked or pre-unlocked, it will remain in that state even if the condition is no longer satisfied (e.g. if you lose population, you can still build what you could build before).
A new global variable: green spaces, is the sum of all the *beauty* you have.

[h3][b]New buildings[/b][/h3]
Lumberjack cabin has an upgrade: lumberjack house
There are now two coal plants.
There is another type of park that is unlocked when you reach a certain level of green spaces.

[h3][b]Game options[/b][/h3]
At the start of the game, you can select
- Size of the map: now you can choose a bigger map
- Map type: river size, coastal
- World: temperate or desert

[h3][b]New world: Desert[/b][/h3]
Must be unlocked and has other rules and new constructions.

[h3][b]Remaining problems[/b][/h3]
On the southeast edge the buildings can go over the edge.
Sometimes tooltips get stuck
Sometimes cars go inside houses.
When walking, one can fall off the map
